sentences.text: The review covers wellbore 15/9-F-9 A (Sodir wellbore 6163) on the VOLVE field, with 28 daily reports from 2009-07-03 to 2016-10-23.
The report span is 2670.0 days, with 28 active days in 3 campaigns.
Total depth is 1206.0 m measured depth and 1013.0 m true vertical depth, the deepest values reported; Sodir gives the same total depth of 1206.0 m.
Total activity time is 555.75 h. Primary lost time is 60.25 h, which is 10.84 % of the activity time.
Possible lost time is reported separately at 61.75 h (11.11 % of activity time) and is not included in the primary figures.

Sodir records entry on 2009-07-01 and completion on 2009-07-09, the end of drilling; the later reports belong to a 2015 workover and a 2016 plug and abandonment, which the completion date does not cover.

The 2009 completion was handed over to production with the record "WELL HANDED OVER TO PRODUCTION" on 2009-07-14; the well was later worked over with an ESP and then plugged and abandoned, and Sodir lists its status as P&A.
Campaign 1 ran from 2009-07-03 to 2009-07-14, a span of 12.0 days with 12 active days; its dominant operation phase was drilling.
Campaign 2 ran from 2015-01-26 to 2015-02-04, a span of 10.0 days with 10 active days; its dominant operation phase was workover.
Campaign 3 ran from 2016-09-28 to 2016-10-23, a span of 26.0 days with 6 active days; its dominant operation phase was plug abandon.
Section 1 is the 12.25 in hole, drilled from 2009-07-03 to 2009-07-06.

It ran from 436.0 m to 997.0 m MD, with 903.3 m TVD at section end, and drilled 561.0 m of new hole at an average 17.26 m/h while coded as drilling; this is not an on-bottom rate. Section activity totals 91.25 h.
Section 2 is the 8.5 in hole, drilled on 2009-07-07 from 997.0 m to 1051.0 m MD, with 930.0 m TVD at section end.
It drilled 54.0 m of new hole at an average 13.5 m/h while coded as drilling, not an on-bottom rate.
Section 3 has an unknown hole size (not reported). It was drilled on 2009-07-08 to 1206.0 m MD and 1013.0 m TVD, with 155.0 m of new hole at an average 12.92 m/h while coded as drilling.
Section 4 has an unknown hole size. It ran from 2009-07-09 to 2009-07-10 at 1206.0 m MD with no new hole and 48.0 h of activity; no drilling rate is given because no time is coded as drilling.
Section 5 has an unknown hole size. It ran from 2009-07-11 to 2009-07-14 at 1206.0 m MD with no new hole, 93.75 h of activity and no drilling rate.
Section 6 is a workover section with an unknown hole size; it ran from 2015-01-26 to 2015-01-28 at 1206.0 m MD with 56.5 h of activity and no new hole. TVD is not reported for this section.
Section 7 ran from 2015-01-29 to 2015-01-31 at 1206.0 m MD with 72.0 h of activity; TVD is not reported.
Section 8 ran on 2015-02-01 at 1206.0 m MD with 24.0 h of activity; TVD is not reported.
Section 9 ran on 2015-02-02 at 1206.0 m MD with 24.0 h of activity; TVD is not reported.
Section 10 ran from 2015-02-03 to 2015-02-04 at 1206.0 m MD with 27.5 h of activity; TVD is not reported.
Section 11 is a moving section on 2016-09-28 with 7.75 h of activity; no measured depth is reported.
Section 12 is the plug and abandonment section, ran from 2016-09-29 to 2016-10-23 with 63.0 h of activity; no measured or true vertical depth is reported.
Section 1 started below a casing shoe at 436.5 m MD and set a casing shoe at 996.0 m MD; the activity record names the casing run as "9 5/8" liner".
Section 2 started below the 996.0 m shoe and set no casing.
Section 3 also started below the 996.0 m shoe and set no casing.
Sections 4 to 12 each started below a casing shoe at 1201.0 m MD; none of them set a casing shoe, as the tools report no shoe for these sections.
The completion screens are recorded as "6 5/8" screens" run on 2009-07-09, in the section that started below the 1201.0 m shoe.
Primary lost time totals 60.25 h, which is 10.84 % of the 555.75 h activity time of the wellbore.
By section, primary lost time is 11.25 h in section 5 (12.0 % of that section's activity), 3.25 h in section 6 (5.75 %) and 21.75 h in section 7 (30.21 %).

Further primary lost time is 3.5 h in section 8 (14.58 %), 1.25 h in section 9 (5.21 %), 1.5 h in section 10 (5.45 %) and 17.75 h in section 12 (28.17 %); sections 1 to 4 and section 11 have no primary lost time.
By cause, primary lost time is 47.5 h of repair, 9.75 h of waiting on weather and 3.0 h of fishing.
Possible lost time is reported separately and is not added to the primary figures: 61.75 h in total, of which 39.0 h is coded as other, 13.25 h as maintenance and 9.5 h as waiting.

Possible lost time by section is 4.0 h in section 1, 2.5 h in section 4, 7.75 h in section 5, 4.75 h in section 6, 27.75 h in section 7, 6.75 h in section 8 and 4.5 h in section 11; these are kept apart from the primary figures.
On 2009-07-03 repeated attempts to take a GMWD survey failed with an equipment failure; this is 1.0 h of possible lost time.
On 2009-07-05 the liner needed several attempts to pass the casing window, a 2.75 h operation that is coded with no lost time.
On 2009-07-08 the cluster-shot survey attempts were recorded as "surveys out of specification" while the hole was being drilled; no lost time is coded for them.
On 2009-07-12 tubing joints were laid out "due to bad connections" during the completion string run.

claims.value: Could not disconnect riser from well head.

sentences.text: On 2009-07-14 the riser could not be disconnected from the wellhead; the record reads "Could not disconnect riser from well head." and the lock-ring troubleshooting that followed is 11.25 h of primary repair time.
On 2015-01-26 the spacer spool and tubing bonnet would not lift; they were freed on 2015-01-27 after the rig-up was changed, a total of 2.75 h coded as workover time with no lost time.
On 2015-01-27 a fault in the smart zone of the drill-floor equipment stopped operations for 2.0 h of primary repair time.

On 2015-01-28 the casing guide arm was repaired for 1.25 h of primary time, and missing armour was observed on the ESP cable pulled out of hole (quote: "missing armor on ESP cable"), with a 4.5 h crew-change stop coded as possible lost time.
Section 7 (2015-01-29 to 2015-01-31) carried the Timelock plug problems: the first setting attempt on 2015-01-29 failed and cost 2.0 h of primary time, and the pressure test later failed.

claims.value: open needle valve on surface wellhead

sentences.text: The pressure loss was traced to an "open needle valve on surface wellhead" on 2015-01-30, and the plug was later set, retrieved and reset several times.

claims.value: released from interlock, fell out and landed off on top of the riser

sentences.text: On 2015-01-31 the diverter inserts were released from the interlock and fell onto the riser (quote: "released from interlock, fell out and landed off on top of the riser"); diverter handling and insert recovery took 7.25 h of primary time.
On 2015-02-02 a tubing joint was found with "observed damaged threads" and the evaluation was coded as 0.75 h of primary time.
On 2015-02-03 a fault on the PRS needed hydraulic fitting repairs, 1.5 h of primary time.
On 2016-09-29 a tubing string was dropped, recorded as "Accidently dropped", and this stop is 0.75 h of primary time.

claims.value: Not able to engage the fish

sentences.text: Fishing with a spear BHA followed on 2016-09-29; the spear was "Not able to engage the fish", and the three fishing runs total 3.0 h of primary time.

claims.value: Observed bull nose missing in the well

sentences.text: The record notes "Observed bull nose missing in the well", and a mechanical plug (EZSV) and a cement plug were placed on 2016-09-30.

claims.value: Waited on weather to pull production riser on F-15 D

sentences.text: From 2016-10-16 the operation waited on weather, recorded as "Waited on weather to pull production riser on F-15 D", for 9.75 h of primary time.

The Sodir completion date of 2009-07-09 is earlier than the last report on 2016-10-23 because the 2015 workover and the 2016 plug and abandonment are separate campaigns that followed the 2009 completion.
Test and back up the survey tools before the next well: the GMWD attempt on 2009-07-03 cost 1.0 h of possible time, and cluster-shot surveys were out of specification on 2009-07-08.
Check the riser lock ring and release bolts before the completion handover: releasing the riser on 2009-07-14 needed 11.25 h of primary repair.
Rig up tubing-bonnet lifts with a checked sling arrangement before the first attempt: the 2015-01-26 lift took 2.75 h to free.
Qualify the plug setting and pressure-test the surface lines before running a plug: section 7 carried 21.75 h of primary time, 30.21 % of its activity, mostly from the Timelock plug failures.
Inspect tubing threads before make-up: damaged threads were found on 2015-02-02, and the tubing string was dropped on 2016-09-29, which led to 3.0 h of fishing.
Plan riser recovery for a weather window: the 2016 campaign lost 9.75 h of primary time waiting on weather.
Code lost time consistently in the daily reports: 39.0 h of possible time is coded as other and should be reviewed so the primary share of 10.84 % is not understated.

row.comments: Made several attempts to take GMWD survey without success.

Ran in hole with 9 5/8" liner from 423 m to 424, 4 m. Took weight at 424, 4 m (Casing window). Maximum set down weight 17 tons. Made several attempts to pass through window with various orientations. BO last liner joint and installed same in hydraulic mouse hole. Installed circulation swage and DP safety valve. Stabbed liner joint and circulation assembly with PRS. Made up liner joint with casing tong. Connected TDS.
Ran in hole with 9 5/8" liner from 40 m to 330 m. Filled every 3rd liner joint with 1, 40 sg mud.

Pulled out of hole from 1200 m to 1192 m. Attempted to take cluster shot survey; surveys out of specification. Took max 30 ton over pull when moving string. Pumped out of hole from 1192 m to 1158 m with 1700 lpm, 81 bar.
Picked up, made up and ran in hole with 6 5/8" screens to 199 m.
LO 3 joints of tubing due to bad connections.
Continued attempts to pull riser. Moved riser, adjusted bolts, tried to re-position lock ring.
Leak tested bonnet cavity to 69 bar / 10 min. OK. Meanwhile started to disconnect kelly hose. END OF OPERATION F - 9A. WELL HANDED OVER TO PRODUCTION.
Could not disconnect riser from well head. Contacted town, trouble shot.
Troubleshot problems with lock ring between riser and wellhead. TBT with on comming crew.
Adjusted release bolts to press lock ring in centre. Took 3 ton over pull, slacked off to neutral. Continued to adjust stroke of bolts. Riser free.
Attempted to lift spacer spool and tubing bonnet without success, +/- 3 ton overpull. Slacked off weight and retried several times. No movement.

Reconfigured rig up and installed a 5 ton chain hoist for better control over weight taken. Simultaneously loosened ALT-2 release bolts. Attempted to lift tubing bonnet and spacer spool, 4 ton overpull, little movement observed, but still not free.
Removed chain hoist and re-attached double slings to ensure straight-up lift. Pulled up, backed out release bolts and pulled tubing bonnet free. Covered tubing hanger with bucket.
Problems with smart zone on drillfloor equipment. Stop in operation. Electrical technician investigated problems. Meanwhile performed TBT for running TH RT with new crew.
Troubleshot and function tested guide arm on HTS. Meanwhile repaired Weatherford casing guide; removed guide arm, checked and secured piston.

Secured drillfloor. Stop in operation due to crew change.
Meanwhile observed missing armor on ESP cable pulled out of hole.

Attempted to set Timelock plug according to Archer procedures. Made 3 attempts without sucess. Archer rep contacted onshore support for advice. Performed TBT with new crew. Observed that the plug was not at the required setting depth - attempted set in 13 3/8" casing. RIH with Timelock plug from 395 m to 424 m.
Continued troubleshoot loss off pressure. Narrowed causes to a open needle valve on surface wellhead. Closed needle valve.
R/U for pulling diverter. Held TBT with new crew.
Installed lifting eyes and bridle. Pulled diverter inserts. 10" diverter inserts released from interlock, fell out and landed off on top of the riser.
Evaluated situation. Troubleshot to recover 10" inserts.
Planned and prepared retrieval tool to recover 10" inserts.
Tested retrieval tool. Good test.
Installed remaining retrieval tools and prepared for lifting 10" inserts.
Lifted 10" diverter inserts and recovered same to drill floor. Performed AAR with involved personnel
Performed TBT for pulling diverter.
Pulled diverter and R/B same.
P/U first 7 5/8" tubing joint from HTS. Attempted to M/U same to ESP assy. Not able to get good connection. Trouble to B/O connection. B/O and observed damaged threads. L/O tubing joint.
Evaluated situation.
Troubleshot PRS. Repaired hydraulic fittings on forward PRS upper head.
Accidently dropped 212m of tubing string by operator error. Performed time out for safety conversation with all involved. Took pictures
P/U and M/U spear BHA to fish 7 5/8in tubing string. RIF and tagged top of the fish at 200m
Worked string f/ 200.1m to 200.7m with up to 6t WOB while rotating at 5rpm CCW 5kNM. Not able to engage the fish
POOH w/ spear BHA from 200m to surface. Inspected spear. Observed bull nose missing in the well
Established circulation and washed the setting area, 550 l/min/ 4 bar. Installed the 13 3/8  EZSV plug at 199,2 m top of plug (35 right hand turns). Load tested the plug with 10t down weight

Waited on weather to pull production riser on F-15 D

Meanwhile:
Performed TBT for skidding to F-9 A and tag TOC
